purpose: Connect the existing 40-agent social-content workflow to an executable video-generation backend.

modes: image-to-video when the selected model/provider supports it
generation_layer.credential: HF_TOKEN environment variable or Space secret; never store credentials in Git
generation_layer.fallback_policy: Fail clearly and allow operator to select another supported model/provider; do not claim generation succeeded without a returned video file.

agent_roles: Coordinate dependencies, state, approvals, retries, and lineage.
Collect current trend evidence and audience signals.
Select concepts based on brand, trends, and measured performance.
Write scene concepts and narrative beats.
Optimize the opening action and curiosity gap.
Create controlled variants and isolate variables.
Specify shot, movement, lighting, and cinematography.
Require current approved reference assets for identity-sensitive work.
Submit the generation request to a real model/provider and collect the resulting file.
Reject material identity drift; never infer a pass from generation success alone.
Validate container, duration, resolution, frame integrity, and encoding.
Generate platform-specific captions, keywords, hashtags, and CTA.
Route approved media to publishing; require confirmation.
Check brand integrity, safety, and visual standards.
Identify press opportunities and media signals.
Manage journalist discovery and outreach tracking.
Track impersonation signals and escalation records.
Coordinate authority, PR, and verification workflows.
Retrieve approved binary assets and validate integrity.
Luna Media Decode & Frame Extraction Agent
Extract inspection derivatives without modifying masters.
Luna Asset Registry & Identity Loader Agent
Load verified references and block retired substitutes.
Use fresh evidence for trend/audio claims; do not extract copyrighted Reel audio.
Analyze first frame, curiosity, interruption, text, audio, and payoff.
Analyze available retention and engagement metrics without inventing missing data.
Generate controlled variants of validated winners.
Select tests by evidence, confidence, novelty, and learning value.
Adapt opening, duration, cover, caption, CTA, and timing.
Record tested formulas, outcomes, confidence, and failure modes.
Choose scale, iterate, hold, retire, or investigate.
constraints: A provider request is not success until a usable video file is returned.
Never store tokens in source control.
Never extract or embed copyrighted Instagram audio from other creators' content.
